scope: all optimizer source-card families and small transferable components

entries.title: AdamW
entries.when_to_try: Reference final-student adaptation and matched optimizer control
entries.triggering_evidence: Matched complete endpoint before changing update geometry
entries.first_experiment: Keep the faithful final AdamW+OneCycle stage; compare a named alternative at fixed parent/data/objective.

entries.title: RAdam
entries.when_to_try: Early adaptive-step instability or sensitive warmup
entries.triggering_evidence: Actual early loss/step-scale/skip diagnostics
entries.first_experiment: One matched GRU512 arm; keep OneCycle and disclose its existing warmup overlap.

entries.title: AdaBelief
entries.when_to_try: Gradient direction varies across heterogeneous targets
entries.triggering_evidence: Gradient residual versus momentum structure
entries.first_experiment: Match AdamW budget and define epsilon/decay; compare endpoint and component contribution.

entries.title: Adafactor
entries.when_to_try: Larger teachers make optimizer-state memory significant
entries.triggering_evidence: Measured optimizer-state share, not total VRAM alone
entries.first_experiment: Factor recurrent matrix moments with explicit relative-step and update-clipping treatment.

entries.title: Muon hybrid
entries.when_to_try: Recurrent representations benefit from matrix update geometry
entries.triggering_evidence: Own positive Muon evidence plus actual device profile
entries.first_experiment: Reconstruct strong-parent stage, then compare stage-specific use against AdamW.

entries.title: NorMuon
entries.when_to_try: Orthogonalized updates have unequal row/neuron scales
entries.triggering_evidence: Actual row-norm dispersion in Muon updates
entries.first_experiment: Add row-second-moment normalization only; same architecture and objective.

entries.title: Polar Express
entries.when_to_try: Polar approximation dominates optimizer time or fidelity
entries.triggering_evidence: Measured NS optimizer share and approximation stability
entries.first_experiment: Replace the matrix subroutine only, keeping outer momentum/scaling/decay fixed.

entries.title: Scion norm-constrained updates
entries.when_to_try: Width scaling or bounded operator geometry may change training
entries.triggering_evidence: Predeclared recurrent norm/radius and actual stability
entries.first_experiment: One norm/radius recipe versus Muon; do not borrow transformer scaling without a test.

entries.title: Shampoo
entries.when_to_try: Cross-coordinate curvature limits progress
entries.triggering_evidence: Matched endpoint and affordable factor-update profile
entries.first_experiment: Bound block size/preconditioner frequency, preserve full state for checkpoints.

entries.title: SOAP
entries.when_to_try: Adam directions may improve in a matrix covariance eigenbasis
entries.triggering_evidence: Affordable eigensystem refresh plus fixed-budget endpoint
entries.first_experiment: One recurrent-block SOAP arm versus AdamW/Muon, with explicit refresh frequency.

entries.title: SPlus
entries.when_to_try: Whitening stability and iterate averaging may improve the endpoint
entries.triggering_evidence: Measured state overhead and saved-versus-served iterate semantics
entries.first_experiment: Bound one whitening/averaging recipe; compare full served endpoint, not training loss alone.

entries.title: DASH
entries.when_to_try: Preconditioner implementation costs obstruct useful curvature tests
entries.triggering_evidence: Measured inverse-root/factor overhead
entries.first_experiment: Test accelerated block preconditioning at fixed mathematical treatment where possible.

entries.title: K-FAC
entries.when_to_try: Recurrent gradient covariance suggests a structured curvature advantage
entries.triggering_evidence: A recurrent-compatible factorization and bounded cost
entries.first_experiment: Small full-sequence component screen; charge curvature-estimator work explicitly.

entries.title: Lion/sign momentum
entries.when_to_try: A low-state direction or different magnitude sensitivity may provide diversity
entries.triggering_evidence: Prespecified LR protocol and actual weighted-regression behavior
entries.first_experiment: Matched finite run with sign updates; measure standalone and teacher/blend contribution.

entries.title: SGD/momentum/Nesterov
entries.when_to_try: Coordinate adaptivity may obscure a useful alternative training path
entries.triggering_evidence: Small controlled LR/momentum protocol
entries.first_experiment: Compare nonadaptive direction at fixed loss/order/clipping, with explicit schedule.

entries.title: Schedule-Free
entries.when_to_try: Schedule sensitivity or averaging may limit adaptation
entries.triggering_evidence: Correct training/evaluation iterate and matched full compute cost
entries.first_experiment: AdamW-based schedule-free versus OneCycle, exporting its prescribed evaluation weights.

entries.title: Prodigy
entries.when_to_try: Effective step scale is difficult to choose for a new stage
entries.triggering_evidence: Step-size trace and interaction with the external scheduler
entries.first_experiment: A frozen adaptive-step protocol versus tuned fixed-LR anchor, not a silent OneCycle substitution.

entries.title: D-Adaptation
entries.when_to_try: Learning-rate scale uncertainty across teacher/students
entries.triggering_evidence: Measured adaptation trace under the same objective
entries.first_experiment: One adaptive-scale control; compare with Prodigy without claiming parameter-free means no choices.

entries.title: Sophia
entries.when_to_try: Diagonal curvature/clipped steps may help noisy regression
entries.triggering_evidence: Affordable Hessian-estimator work and stability
entries.first_experiment: Bound estimator frequency/clip constants and count estimator backward work.

entries.title: Muon whole matrix versus per gate
entries.when_to_try: Coupling GRU gates may change useful recurrent representations
entries.triggering_evidence: Reference-source grouping versus our own grouping
entries.first_experiment: Match outer optimizer/schedule and change only grouping; compare fixed endpoint.

entries.title: Muon recurrent-only versus hidden matrices
entries.when_to_try: Input/readout geometry may matter alongside the recurrent core
entries.triggering_evidence: Explicit source-selected parameter names and gradient shares
entries.first_experiment: Compare recurrent-only with one declared wider scope; keep biases on an appropriate vector optimizer.

entries.title: Muon RMS/shape/LR scaling
entries.when_to_try: Width and update magnitude may distort optimizer comparisons
entries.triggering_evidence: Actual group update-to-weight ratios and schedule traces
entries.first_experiment: Test explicit LR multiplier/shape scaling while holding grouping and momentum fixed.

entries.title: Stage-specific optimizer handoff
entries.when_to_try: Representation learning and fine-tuning may need different geometry
entries.triggering_evidence: Reference Muon parent/fresh AdamW final stage and own evidence
entries.first_experiment: Faithful handoff anchor versus a named final-stage Muon variant; specify whether state resets.

entries.title: LR schedule and beta1 coupling
entries.when_to_try: A cooldown result can arise from momentum as well as LR
entries.triggering_evidence: Actual per-attempt LR/beta1 trace
entries.first_experiment: Compare named OneCycle/WSD/SGDR packages first; isolate LR shape with matched beta1 in a descendant.

entries.title: Finite plateau reheating/noise
entries.when_to_try: A fitted trajectory may plateau in a narrow region
entries.triggering_evidence: A predeclared fitting-only trigger and finite noise/reheat budget
entries.first_experiment: Use the Astra bounded trigger recipe; no evaluated-group checkpoint selection.

entries.title: Muon matrix precision/device policy
entries.when_to_try: A hardware numerical path may change feasible training cost
entries.triggering_evidence: Actual optimizer step/device capability and finite updates
entries.first_experiment: Explicit native-BF16-or-FP32 policy profile; execution evidence alone is not scientific optimizer superiority.

allocation: Faithful Muon-parent/AdamW-student blend first; bounded independent contrasts in parallel. Registration grants no fit admission; low standalone score does not reject conditional teacher/blend value.
